headline: A Great Patriot and National Treasure
dek: The President congratulates the NVIDIA board for bringing Jensen Huang back as CEO, ten days after saying Tim Cook should replace him. Meanwhile, at a real American kitchen table…

original.speaker: Donald J. Trump
text: The NVIDIA Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO. The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at NVIDIA in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy. The United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security. The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct. On a personal note, I have gotten to know Jensen, and he is a Great Patriot and National Treasure. Separately, NVIDIA should continue its thorough internal investigation of the Company’s compliance with U.S. export controls in order to ensure that it is fulfilling its legal obligations and Patriotic Duty to protect U.S. National Security. Congratulations to Jensen, the NVIDIA Board, to the People of the United States — and, indeed, the World! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
original.key: The NVIDIA Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO.
original.context: Posted on 23 November 2026. On 12 November, the President had written that Tim Cook should take Jensen Huang’s place (see “A Legend replaces a Legend”). The account of the investigation and of the Attorney General’s findings is the President’s. Steve is a fictional character.

verification.note: Copied by the editor from truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump on 23 November 2026 (shown as 11/23/26, 6:07 AM Pacific).

meanwhile.hook: Trump congratulates Jensen Huang on getting his job back. *Meanwhile, at Steve’s house…*
meanwhile.highlight: he is a Great Patriot and National Treasure
steve: Jensen got his job back? Good for him.
When I lost mine, nobody posted that I was a National Treasure.
*My board of directors is my wife. She was less forgiving.*

fact.text: Americans were unemployed in October 2026 (4.1%); 27.6% of them had been looking for work for 27 weeks or more.
